g.text: A11 ARC STUDY - 5V power and Pi control

g.desc: A11 ARC STUDY - 5V power and Pi control

g.text: 5V regulated input only. U6 is now WSON-6 with grounded thermal pad.

g.text: R1/R2 DNP: use one I2C pull-up set at HAT; bus <=100 kHz. Both boards powered together.
